result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk but lacks signals and has significantly degraded sidewalk infrastructure on one side. The presence of one-way traffic and parked vehicles near the crossing point creates potential visibility and safety challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is crumbling and uneven, creating a trip hazard and accessibility barrier.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians at the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is placed directly in the path of the sidewalk, narrowing the accessible width.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a continuous, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes at the crossing points.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals, providing essential infrastructure for walkers. However, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures, and parked vehicles near the crossing may create visibility issues for pedestrians entering the roadway.

hazards.name: Visibility obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic calming
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway lacks physical features to slow down turning or through traffic, increasing the risk of high-speed conflicts.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide vertical enclosure, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds and improves the pedestrian experience.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads. The roadway surface shows signs of degradation, and the overall environment is dominated by asphalt with no street trees or physical traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and crosswalk area can cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to remove cracks and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure, including functional crosswalk markings and dedicated pedestrian signals. While a sidewalk exists on the left, the right side of the street is unpaved, forcing pedestrians into potentially hazardous conditions.

hazards.name: Missing/Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The lack of visible crosswalk markings fails to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians and does not alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Incomplete Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, creating an inaccessible and unsafe environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide adequate clearance time or clear direction.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Installation
interventions.description: Apply continental-style pavement markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.
